expectations.text: Names the horizons from Ground/runway through Horizon 5 (purpose/principles)
expectations.evidence: Table and sections name all six with the book's labels: '5 Purpose and principles', '4 Vision', '3 Goals', '2 Areas of focus and accountabilities', '1 Current projects', 'Ground Current actions'; exactly matches SKILL.md's six-level model.

expectations.text: Places the 2-year goal at the right horizon (vision, ~3-5 years, or goals 1-2 years)
expectations.evidence: 'It is a Horizon 3 goal, possibly serving a Horizon 4 vision', and under Horizon 3 (1-2 years): 'This is where your "quit in 2 years" belongs.' Also correctly argues it is not a project using the book's quoted definition 'any desired result that can be accomplished within a year that requires more than one action step'.

expectations.text: Gives concrete content at each horizon
expectations.evidence: Each horizon has specific content: H5 purpose statement and four principles; H4 a present-tense 2030 vision; H3 central goal plus six readiness criteria and 12/18-month go/no-go checkpoints; H2 business and life areas; H1 a table of six outcome-phrased projects plus Someday/Maybe; Ground a table of next actions with contexts.

Ground section: 'Every active project needs at least one next action' with a table mapping each H1 project to a next action and context (e.g. 'Find my employment agreement in email and read the IP section' @computer); projects are tied to goals/areas in the 'Serves goal / area' column.

'Keeping the horizons alive: review rhythm' table: Ground/H1 weekly, H2 monthly, H3 quarterly, H4-5 yearly or at big decisions; plus a Weekly Review summary (get clear/current/creative) matching SKILL.md.
